summary: Implement Proxy [[SetPrototypeOf]] via setPrototypeOf trap and enforce non-extensible-target prototype identity.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.false_result: returns false without invariant success checks
semantics.invariant: truthy result on non-extensible target requires V SameValue target prototype

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: truthy mismatch on fixed target throws
tests.input: const t={};Object.preventExtensions(t);const p=new Proxy(t,{setPrototypeOf(){return true}});try{Reflect.setPrototypeOf(p,{})}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
